titleEn: Request a refund of the wallet balance

en: How do I request a refund?

steps: After the plan ends or is cancelled, within 12 months, 50 EGP minimum, up to available balance; add a note; the team reviews
edgeCases: Reasons: plan_still_active, period_not_ended, window_passed, below_minimum, exceeds_refundable
Not refundable: card fees, package AI credits, current period, used/old purchased credits
States: pending, rejected, processing, paid, manual payout, failed, abandoned
Help text "subject to final terms" (legal check pending)
gaps: Decision is operator-only (see operator.refund-decision); no SLA shown
